title: Export stack
description: Writes frames of a stack to a file, a chunk at a time, as dev's imviewer exports a stack: TIFF (a page per frame), dev's binary stack (a .raw beside its .ini), NumPy .npy, or a video (Motion JPEG AVI of 8-bit frames, the values from low to high scaled to 0..255; both 0 for the 0.5th and 99.5th percentiles of the first frames). A relative path is in the project's folder, and {field} tokens in it are the entity's values. Of a stack with channels or planes, one channel and plane are written. Video needs imageio and imageio-ffmpeg in Python (the video extra).

path.title: File
path.description: Where the file is written; relative to the project's folder unless absolute. Give it the format's extension (.tif, .raw, .npy, .avi).

lastFrame.title: Last frame
lastFrame.description: 0 for the last frame of the stack.

low.title: Video: lowest value
low.description: Shown as black; low and high both 0 for the 0.5th and 99.5th percentiles of the first frames.
